name: Factory Showcase
description: One connected factory: raw ore, wood, stone and sand in at the west end, the Works Runabout built at the east end, every production machine working on the way. Read the signs, press Start on both consoles, then pick Works Runabout at the Building Station.

text: 1 POWER. MAIN SWITCH: off = every machine No power
RAW STOCK: filled in creative, empty in survival
2 REFINERY: press Start on this console
Ore to metal; metal and stone to steel
Wood to planks; planks and sand to rubber
Copper ore to copper; copper and metal to bronze
Planks to cloth; sand to glass
3 THE YARD: every refined material, in bins
4 ASSEMBLY: two Assemblers, each feeds the other
5 PRESS HALL: blanks in from the south, parts out north
6 PANELS: sheet in, formed panels out
LASER CUTTER: a panel in, a cut part out
GLASS: formed glass sheet for the panes
WHEELS: rubber in, a formed wheel out
ROUTER: ordered pieces to the station, the rest to the rack
7 BUILDING STATION: F, pick Works Runabout, Start
TOOL ROOM: the lathe cuts the bracket press's die
CRAFTING TERMINAL: F, order a part, it rides here
PANEL DESIGNER: design a panel; it is formed for you
RECYCLER: drop a wreck in; its metal goes to steel
ORDERS: Start runs every maker; the station orders here
